explanation: Searched for other statements of the form `Dense s → Dense (s \ t)` for finsets/finite sets: the only near-matches are in the same file, namely the deprecated alias `Dense.diff_finset` (same declaration, doesn't count) and `Dense.sdiff_finite` (line 708), whose proof is literally `convert hs.sdiff_finset ht.toFinset`, i.e. it depends on the target theorem, so it is circular and cannot serve as independent evidence. Other `Dense.*` results (Dense.inter_of_isOpen_right/left, Dense.sdiff_singleton, dense_compl_singleton, Dense.mono, etc.) only give the ingredient facts, and deriving the finset statement from them would take a genuine induction argument, not one or two lines. No independent Mathlib duplicate found.
